description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the AccessTokenRepository in an OAuth implementation within the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup procedures and tests for creating, persisting, revoking, and retrieving OAuth access tokens.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the AccessTokenRepository, testing creation, persistence, revocation, and retrieval of OAuth access tokens.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data and configures the AccessTokenRepository before each test.

methods.name: testGetNewToken
methods.description: Tests creation of a new access token and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenWithScopes
methods.description: Tests creation of a new token with scopes and verifies scope serialization.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenAndCallGetExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Tests invoking getExpiryDateTime() on a newly created token, expecting an error if uninitialized.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenAndCallGetIdentifier
methods.description: Tests invoking getIdentifier() on a newly created token, expecting an error if uninitialized.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Tests persisting a new access token to the database and verifying stored data.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessTokenWithExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Tests that persisting a token with a duplicate identifier throws a constraint violation.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Tests revoking an existing access token and verifies it is marked revoked.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessTokenWhichAlreadyRevoked
methods.description: Ensures revoking an already revoked token retains the revoked state.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Tests revoking a non-existent token, should silently succeed.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Verifies that the system correctly identifies a revoked token.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevokedForNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Checks that the system returns false for non-existent tokens.

methods.name: testGetAccessToken
methods.description: Tests retrieving access tokens by their token string and handling invalid tokens.
